protocol: 52 USAF chamber groups of men. Repetitive exercise in 575 exposures, predominantly lower body in 457. Mean test pressure 5.8 psia, duration 4.66 h and tissue ratio 1.92 (0.90–2.98).
outcome_window: From arrival at the final test pressure to symptom report or the scheduled end of the chamber exposure.
note: Source-designated external validation for the 1996 model. VGE unavailable. Test-level identities and overlap with indexed historical cohorts are unresolved.

protocol: Three oxygen prebreathing validation tests during wartime high-altitude bombing research. About 3.0 psia for 2–4 h.
outcome_window: From arrival at the final test pressure to symptom report or the scheduled end of the chamber exposure.
locator: External Validation and Fig. 6, printed p. 182 (PDF p. 7)
note: Nested within the 326/1,009 validation sample. The authors describe possible underreporting of mild symptoms. Three separate group denominators are unavailable.
